Theorem
[Coarea formula] 1. appC:thm-5\group Coarea Formula Let $u:\mathbb R^n\to \mathbb R$ be Lipschitz continuous and assume that, for almost every $r\in \mathbb R$, the level set \[ \{ x\in \mathbb R^n\mid u(x)=r\} \] is a smooth $(n-1)$-dimensional hypersurface. If $f:\mathbb R^n\to \mathbb R$ is continuous and summable, then \[ \int _{\mathbb R^n}f|Du|\, dx =\int _{-\infty }^\infty \left(\int _{\{ u=r\} }f\, dS\right)\, dr. \]

Theorem 1.3 follows from Theorem 1.3 by taking $u(x)=|x-x_0|$; see \cite[Chapter 3]{EvansGariepy1992}.
